title: Transformers — More than meets the eye

hook.context: Autobotlar yetakchisi jamoasiga yo'lga chiqish buyrug'ini beradi. "roll out" — phrasal verb: g'ildirab yo'lga tushmoq, harakatni boshlamoq. Buyruq maylida ega yo'q: Roll out!

reading: Sam Witwicky is an ordinary teenager. He doesn't have much money, so he buys an old yellow car with the little money his father gives him.
Sam soon discovers that the car is not a car at all. It is Bumblebee, a robot from another planet who can change his shape.

Many years ago, there was a war on the planet Cybertron between two groups of robots: the good Autobots and the evil Decepticons. Both groups are now looking for the AllSpark, a cube with a lot of power.
The AllSpark is somewhere on Earth, and a few clues about its location are hidden in the glasses of Sam's great-great-grandfather.
Sam has very little experience of danger, but he has some courage. With the help of Mikaela, a girl from his school, and a few soldiers, he decides to protect the cube.
There aren't many Autobots on Earth, and the Decepticons have a lot of weapons. There is very little time to stop them.
In the end, a lot of buildings are destroyed, but Sam saves the world. He learns that every small person can make a big difference.

grammar.title: Countable / uncountable: much, many, a lot of, a few, a little
explain: **Sanaladigan** otlar (robot, car, clue) ko'plik oladi: **many** robots, **a few** clues. **Sanalmaydigan** (money, time, power, experience, information) ko'plik olmaydi: **much** money, **a little** time.
**much / many** — asosan inkor va savollarda: He doesn't have **much** money. Are there **many** Autobots? Ijobiy gaplarda ko'proq **a lot of** (ikkala tur uchun): a lot of weapons, a lot of power.
**a few / a little** — oz, lekin yetarli (ijobiy): I have **a few** friends. **few / little** (a siz) — juda oz, yetmaydi (salbiy): He has very **little** experience.
Ehtiyot bo'ling: information, advice, news, furniture, money — sanalmaydi: "many informations" — xato, **much information**, **a piece of** advice.

exercises.why: Ijobiy gap, ko'p miqdor → a lot of.
